posts.alt: 2026 Topps Chrome WWE Garbage Pail Kids Damian Priest refractor short print card.
posts.fb:
Damian Priest won two national championships in full-contact martial arts, trained by his own father. He keeps katanas, sai and nunchucks in his house. His favourite bands are Slayer and Pantera. 🏹

Topps looked at all of that and drew him as a cartoon toddler full of arrows, named him "DAMAGED DAMIAN," and put it on a card.

Someone pitched that in a meeting. Every person in the room said yes. That person is employed. That person is thriving.

2026 Topps Chrome WWE × Garbage Pail Kids, card #GPK-DP. Refractor short print, and a genuine case hit — not a card you casually stumble into.

The GPK crossover is the most fun anybody's had with a wrestling set in ten years, and this is the standout of the run. It rainbows so hard in hand that photographing it is basically a formality.

→ https://www.ebay.com/itm/318731525182

posts.alt: 2026 Topps Chrome WWE Liv Morgan 1986 Topps design gold cracked ice autograph, numbered 35/50.
posts.fb:
This is a 1986 Topps card of a woman born in 1994. Time is fake. The card is real. Try not to think about it too hard. 🏆

Liv Morgan was working at Hooters in New Jersey when WWE signed her at 20. Since then: two-time Women's World Champion, Money in the Bank winner, Royal Rumble winner this year, and a film debut opposite Samuel L. Jackson and Uma Thurman. One of the strangest and best career paths in the business.

2026 Topps Chrome WWE — 1986 Topps design, on-card autograph, card #86T-LM, gold cracked ice parallel, hand-numbered 35/50.

That finish looks like someone shattered a pane of gold glass and slid the card underneath it. Unreasonably good.

→ https://www.ebay.com/itm/318731522341

And if you love the design but the serial number does nothing for you — the plain refractor of the same card is in the store as well. Not going to talk anybody into extra tiny handwriting.
